title: Run Archon workflow
description: Ask the local factory bridge (archon_port_sync.py --serve) to run an Archon workflow for this repository. Archon stays authoritative; this run closes when the Archon run ends.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: archon-triage-block and archon-investigate are advisory (no code changes); archon-ship-block triages, builds, reviews and opens a PR.

target.title: GitHub issue
target.description: Issue URL in this factory's repository, e.g. https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues/123
